content_sections.heading: Amrita Office Assistant - Student Affairs at a Glance
About Amrita Office Assistant - Student Affairs
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research deemed university spread across several states in India. The Amaravati Campus in Andhra Pradesh is currently seeking a dedicated professional for a non-teaching role to support its Student Affairs Office in day-to-day administration, student record management, and event coordination.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the required qualifications should submit their applications or inquiries directly through email to the designated official contact address provided by the institution. content_sections.heading: Amrita Office Assistant - Student Affairs Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be responsible for performing the following duties and responsibilities at the Amaravati Campus: Candidate has to support the Student Affairs Office in day-to-day administrative tasks, student record maintenance, event coordination support, and communication handling. Should have good knowledge in preparing reports, managing student files, scheduling meetings, circulating notices, and helping with logistics during student events and welfare activities. Should be expert in Microsoft Office.
